SCAN_ON_OPEN: Scan when the auction house opens
SCAN_ON_OPEN_TIP: A full scan of the house, at most once every 15 minutes for the account.
CUT_TIP: Taken off what an item brings when it sells.
WINDOW_TIP: Off: the game's own window opens, and the prices stay in the tooltips.
PRICE_LINE_TIP: The Auction line: what one costs on the house, and how old the price is.
